item.title: Hardware manufacturer plans facility in Slinger

item.title: SteelTank Brewing shutters taproom, shifts to new business model
item.description: Oconomowoc-based SteelTank Brewing announced last week that the business will transition to become a contract brewery for other brands.

item.title: Rotary Club of Milwaukee names new executive director
item.description: The Rotary Club of Milwaukee announced today the appointment of Melissa Marschka as its next executive director, succeeding longtime executive director Mary McCormick. Marschka will assume the role on June 15, 2026, following McCormick’s retirement, which was announced in June 2025 following her 24 years as executive director. item.description: The Versiti Blood Research Institute has received $11.5 million in funding to support its pediatric cancer research aimed at accelerating treatments for children facing some of the most devastating forms of cancer.
